local self = require('openmw.self')
local nearby = require('openmw.nearby')
local util = require('openmw.util')
local Actor = require('openmw.types').Actor
local previousFatigue = nil
local debits = 0
local settledAnnounced = false
local timer = 0
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 local fatigue = Actor.stats.dynamic.fatigue(self)
 local current = fatigue.current
 if previousFatigue and previousFatigue-current>1 then debits=debits+1 end
 previousFatigue=current
 if debits==3 and not settledAnnounced and current>=fatigue.base+fatigue.modifier then
  print('M15 course fatigue settled: debits=' .. tostring(debits) .. ' current=' .. tostring(current) .. ' maximum=' .. tostring(fatigue.base+fatigue.modifier))
  settledAnnounced=true
 end
 timer=timer+dt
 if timer<0.1 then return end
 timer=0
 for _, target in ipairs(nearby.actors) do
  if target.recordId == 'FormId:0x1025200' then
   local p,t=self.position,target.position
   local v=t-p
   local forward=self.rotation:apply(util.vector3(0,1,0))
   local distance=v:length()
   local angle=math.deg(math.acos(math.max(-1,math.min(1,(forward.x*v.x+forward.y*v.y)/math.sqrt(v.x*v.x+v.y*v.y)))))
   local mask=nearby.COLLISION_TYPE.World+nearby.COLLISION_TYPE.HeightMap+nearby.COLLISION_TYPE.Door
   local low=nearby.castRay(p+util.vector3(0,0,100),t+util.vector3(0,0,100),{{collisionType=mask}})
   local high=nearby.castRay(p+util.vector3(0,0,125),t+util.vector3(0,0,125),{{collisionType=mask}})
   print(string.format('M15 course geometry: x=%.2f y=%.2f z=%.2f distance=%.2f facing=%.2f blocked100=%s blocked125=%s farFacing=%s rightLane=%s retreated=%s wallLane=%s wallAlong=%s nearWall=%s rangeLane=%s obstacle=%s',p.x,p.y,p.z,distance,angle,tostring(low.hit),tostring(high.hit),tostring(distance>200 and angle<10 and not low.hit and not high.hit),tostring(p.x>=760),tostring(p.y<=-125),tostring(p.x>=788),tostring(p.y>=65),tostring(distance<137 and angle<10 and low.hit and high.hit),tostring(p.x>=708),tostring(low.hitObject and low.hitObject.recordId)))
  end
 end
end}}}}
